g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB03 Direct URL Access to a Protected Section (e.g. /manage/stock typed in the address bar)
The menu (SD 1) only HIDES options. This diagram shows the check that runs whenever a section
is requested by URL, bookmark, browser history or an in-app link (AC 2, AC 3, AC 7).
The page component is mounted ONLY on ALLOW: on every other decision no protected request is made.
[A) Path does not match any section]
returnTo carries ONLY the path (no token, no data, AA04 AC 6).
After login, LoginPage navigates to returnTo only if
known section); otherwise to "/". The guard runs again there.
[B3) ACCOUNT_DENIED (status = "denied": inactive account / no role, AA03)]
[B4) Authenticated: roles must be confirmed before the page is mounted]
by AuthProvider, never by the global handler)
StockPage is NOT mounted: no stock data is requested
or rendered. The message does not reveal the section's
content, the required roles or the user's roles (AC 3).
[B4c) ALLOW (roles contain MANAGER, e.g. [MANAGER] or [CUSTOMER, MANAGER])]
Back-end check on the SAME request (AC 7, AA05):
if the role was removed meanwhile -> 403,
